lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are distributed in a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the gill slits. The spots show a higher density and smaller diameter in the region immediately posterior to the head, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced local maxima along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, most notably in the section posterior to the fifth gill slit, forming a series of recognizable grid nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal feature is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a light-reflective superior edge and a shadowed inferior edge, typical of a lateral ridge or carina.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, visible in the upper right quadrant, contains at least four distinct, high-luminance blobs distributed irregularly within its silhouette, although clarity is reduced by environmental turbidity.

other_distinctive_markers: A smaller teleost fish (likely a remora) is visible as a low-luminance silhouette positioned ventrally to the pectoral fin.
